legendBudget: Carb budget: after an AI analysis, a Filters field lets you set a net-carb budget for the meal. Rule-based results have no carb estimates, so it is not offered.
legendEngines: Rules: KetoClub's own keyword checks on the dish text, with no carb estimate. AI: Gemini reads the whole menu and estimates net carbs.
legendFoodOnly: The score and the counters cover food only. Drinks, sauces and extras are still judged and listed, but are not counted.
legendNote: The same rules KetoClub sends to the AI model.
